book.name: Ruuka
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Ruuka

content: Obhurekya iguru yo okubhagirya abhaatu kukora amabhiihu
Yeesu akabhabhuurira abhaanabheega bhaaye, “Ebhisigo bhino bhiraakore abhaatu bhakore ebhibhi, bhirabhaho kyoomeera. Nawe, araaza kurora omuutu wurya araagakore!
Yiingabheeri hakiriku kumuutu wuyo abhoherwe orubhwe mwiigoti no okurekerwa munyaanza, kukira amugirye owumwe wa abhasuuhu bhano akore ebhibhi.
Kweego, mwiiriihe mutaaza kukora ego! “Eraabhe, omuhiiri waazo araakusariirye, omuhiinye. Eraabhe araate ebhibhi bhyaaye, omwaabhire.
Na eraabhe araakusariirye muhuungati koosi kurusiku orumwe, na niigo araakyoore owaazo muhuungati kweeki abhuge, ‘Niteeri ebhibhi,’ omwaabhire.”
Obhwiikirirya
Niho abheega bhayo bhakamubhuurira Omukuru Yeesu, “Turasabha otwoongereerye obhwiikirirya bhweetu!”
Akabhakyoora, “Nawe muungabheeri no obhwiikirirya bhusuuhu bhukongʼu kye etetere esuuhu bhukongʼu,
muungabhuuriiri omuti gwo omuko guno, ‘Ihika weemibhwe munyaanza!’ nagwe guungabhitegeereeri.
Emirimo gyo omugya
“Tubhuge owumwe weenyu ano omugya wuno akurima kasi arariisya eziingʼoondu. Omugya wuyo araakyoore mumugye, omukuru waaye we emirimo amubhuurire, ‘Awe okore bhwaangu, ikara hano orye ebhyaakurya’?
Zeyi! Amubhuurire, ‘Onikorere ebhyaakurya, na wiibhanure okunihokeerya tee, nimare kurya no okunywa. Niho awe orye no okunywa.’
Ambe, omugya araagakore gano omukuru waaye akamuragania, omukuru wuyo aramubhuurira ozomirye kwo okugakora? Zeyi!
“Niigo ego na neemwe, hano mwiigwiiri gano nibhabhuuriiri, mubhuge, ‘Twoosi ni bhagya ego. Tukoriri kyeego tukeenderwa kukora.’ ”
Yeesu ahorirye abhageenge ikumi
Hano Yeesu yaari kugya Yerusaremu, akahita kumiimbi gatigati ye ebhyaaro bhya Samaria na Gariraaya.
Hano yaari akusikira mumugye gumwe, akasikana na abhageenge ikumi. Abhageenge bhayo bhakiimeerera kure neewe,
bhakatiirya eriiraka bharabhuga, “Omukuru Yeesu! Oturorere ebhigoongi, otuhorye!”
Yeesu akabharora, akabhabhuurira, “Mugeende mwiiyeerekye kubhaseengeri.” Bhakagya, na hano bhaari munzira, bhakahoribhwa.
Owumwe waabhu, hano yaruuzi kubha amariri kuhoribhwa, rugeendo rumwe akakyoora ku Yeesu, aramukumya Taatabhugya kwiiraka ikuru.
Hano yahikiri, akiitaasa bhubhuumari embere wa amaguru ga Yeesu, akamubhuurira, “Ozomirye.” Na omuutu wuyo, yaari Musamaria.
Yeesu akabhuga, “Ndora nikahorya abhaatu ikumi! Keenda bharya bhaari hayi?
Bhatariho bhano bhakyooriri kumukumya Taatabhugya, nawe ni mugya wuno omweene?”
Kyaamwe, Yeesu akamubhuurira, “Imeerera noogye owaazo, obhwiikirirya bhwaazo bhukuhonirye.”
Okwiiriihya iguru yo obhutini bhwe ekiina bhuno bhukuuza

Orusiku rumwe, Abhafarisayo bhakamubhuurya Yeesu, “Obhutemi bhwa Taatabhugya, bhuraaza ryoori?” Yeesu akabhakyoora, “Obhuuzi bhwo obhutemi bhwa Taatabhugya, bhutari ekireengyo kino kikurorekana kwa ameeso.
Abhaatu bhatakunagya kubhuga, ‘Murore! Bhuri hano!’ kasi, ‘Murore! Bhuri harya!’ Mumenye kubha obhutemi bhwa Taatabhugya bhuri gati weenyu.”
Niho Yeesu akabhuurira abhaanabheega bhaaye, “Kuziisiku zino zikuuza, mune enaamba okurora naabhe orusiku rumwe runo enye Omwaana wo Omuutu, nikubha ndakaangata ekyaaro, nawe mutakururora.
Abhaatu bharabhabhuurira, ‘Murore! Wurya harya!’ kasi ‘Murore! Wuno hano!’ Nawe abhaatu bhayo, mutabharyaarira.
Gayo nibhabhuuriiri kwo okubha, enye Omwaana wo Omuutu ndaakyoore, ndaaza kyo orumesyo runo rukumesya mbaara zoosi ze eriisaaro.
Nawe, hano gakubha gakyaari kutuuka, niho enye Omwaana wo Omuutu nireenderwa nibhone enyaako bhukongʼu no okwaangwa na abhaatu bho orwiibhuro runo.
“Kyeego ehaabha kuziisiku zya Nuhu, niigo eraabhe kuziisiku zye enye Omwaana wo Omuutu.
Abhaatu bhaari bhararya no okunywa, bharakweera no okukweerwa, kuziisiku zya Nuhu, tee orusiku rurya Nuhu akasikira musafina. Hayo, omusabhuko gwe embura gukaaza, gukabhasikya bhayo bhoosi.
“Kyeego yaari kuziisiku zya Roti, niigo ego amangʼana garaabhe kuziisiku zye enye Omwaana wo Omuutu. Abhaatu bhaari bhararya no okunywa, bharagura no okusuruzya, bhararima no okwoomboka.
Nawe orusiku rurya hano Roti yarwiiri Sodoma, omuriro omuhaari gwe ekibhiriiti gukiika kurwa mwiisaaro, gukabhasikya bhayo bhoosi.
“Kweego niigo eraabhe orusiku runo enye Omwaana wo Omuutu ndaakuundukurwe.
Orusiku ruyo, omuutu wuyo woosi ari iguru kukisara, atasakya kwiika kugega ebhigiro bhyaaye munyuumba, aryaare. Na wuno akubha mumuguundu, ewe angʼose, atakyoora yiika kugega kyokyoosi.
Muhiite gano gaamubhweeni omukari wa Roti!
Omuutu wowoosi wuno akusakya okuriibha obhwiikari bhwaaye niwe araabhubhurye, no omuutu wuno araabhubhurye, niwe araabhutuurye.
“Ndabhabhuurira kubha, obhutiku bhuyo, abhaatu bhabhiri bharabha bhahiindiiri kubhuriri bhumwe, owumwe aragegwa no owuundi aratama.
Orusiku ruyo, abhakari bhabhiri bharabha bharasya hamwe, owumwe aragegwa no owuundi aratama. [
Kweeki abhasubhe bhabhiri, bharabha bharakora emirimo mumuguundu, owumwe aragegwa no owuundi aratama.]”

Abheega bhakamubhuurya, “Omukuru Yeesu, gayo garakorwa hayi?” Akabhakyoora, “Hano mukurora amatoonyi gariikumania ahagiro, muramenya kubha ekituundu kiri hayo, na niigo mukurora ekitiika kiyo mumenye kubha orusiku ruyo ruhikiri.”

footnotes.text: Etetere esuuhu bhukongʼu, ku Kiyunaani ni tetere ye eharadaari.
Taatabhugya akamuhiinya omukari wa Roti kwo okubha omukari wuyo akabha ne enaamba yo okukyoora Sodoma, omugye guno Taatabhugya ahaabha agutiniiri ekiina no okusikya. Rora Obhweemero 19:26.
